units.source_text: 夕雾这一天所作的诗甚好，考取了进士。

en.t: The poem Yugiri composed that day was excellent, and he passed the examination for the jinshi degree.
The topics on this examination were extremely difficult.

units.source_text: 所选的十个学生虽然都是积有长年修养的贤才，但及第者只有三人。

en.t: Although the ten selected students were all talented men who had cultivated themselves for many years, only three passed.

units.source_text: 秋天京官任免之时，夕雾晋升为五位，当了侍从。

en.t: When court offices in the capital were appointed and dismissed in autumn, Yugiri was promoted to the fifth rank and became a chamberlain.

units.source_text: 他对云居雁始终不能忘怀。

en.t: He still could not forget Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 但内大臣防范极严，使他一筹莫展。

en.t: But the Minister of the Center guarded against him so strictly that he had no way to act.

units.source_text: 他也不强求会面，只是巧觅机会，互通音信而已。

en.t: Nor did he force a meeting; he merely looked skillfully for chances to exchange messages with her.

units.source_text: 真是一对可怜的情人啊！

en.t: What a pitiful pair of lovers they were!
